guide.intro: Hand this page to the integrating team: copy the full text, or export it as a Markdown file. The access address below is substituted into the guide as you edit it.
guide.baseUrlHint: The default may come from platform config, auto-detection or this console's address, and is not necessarily the right API address. Direct connection: http://<backend-ip>:7860; through a gateway: https://<host>[/prefix] (WebSocket uses wss://). Confirm with platform ops before handover, and verify with curl -i <base>/api/v2/auth/whoami: without a key it should return 401/11801; a connection failure, 404 or an HTML page means the address is wrong. Editing here only changes this page and the exported text, not server configuration.
